summary: Valens Semiconductor filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 14, 2026 non-exclusive IP license with Semiconductor Components Industries (onsemi) covering a next-generation integrated image sensor embedding Valens MIPI A-PHY connectivity, in exchange for royalties supporting high-volume 3MP automotive camera applications. The agreement is terminable after ten years for convenience on 180 days' notice, or earlier for material breach, with licenses surviving for roadmap or commercialized products subject to continuing royalties. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation appears. This is an ordinary commercial collaboration, not a special situation; watch royalty disclosure and A-PHY adoption cadence as the value drivers.
